shared_tail.surface: عبد الله بن عبد الرحمن، بن يحنس

notes: two «ح» routes meet at «كلاهما عن ابن جريج»; the names written once after that point are the shared tail, ending at Abu Hurayra whose words («أنه قال») relay the saying
«أبو القاسم» in the saying is the Prophet, the end of the chain, not a link
